LanguageData.Cooler_Over.label: over-wall cooler
LanguageData.Cooler_Over.description: An air-cooling machine that fits into a wall. Cool air comes out one side, while hot exhaust comes out the other. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer, or to create a walk-in freezer.
LanguageData.Cooler_Over2W.label: over-wall cooler (wide)
LanguageData.Cooler_Over2W.description: An air-cooling machine that fits into a wall. Cool air comes out one side, while hot exhaust comes out the other. Can be used to cool down rooms during summer, or to create a walk-in freezer.
LanguageData.Vent_Over.label: over-wall vent
LanguageData.Vent_Over.description: A vent for equalizing the temperature between two rooms without allowing people to walk between them.
